```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(shinyjs)
source("GroupTherapyPatientRandomization.R")
```



Data
=======================================================================

Inputs {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------


```{r echo=FALSE}
shinyjs::useShinyjs()

rSeed = as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", Sys.Date()))

numericInput("RandomSeed", label = "Randomization Seed", value = rSeed)
  
fileInput("existing_patients", label = "File with existing patients", multiple = FALSE, 
            accept = "text/csv", buttonLabel = "CSV file")
  
fileInput("new_patients", label = "File with new patients", multiple = FALSE, 
            accept = "text/csv", buttonLabel = "CSV file")

selectInput("patient_id", label = "Column with patient ID", choices = "")

textAreaInput("spots_k", "Available spots", value = "expA = 3, expB = 1")

sliderInput("randomness", label = "Randomness", value=0.2, min=0.2, max=0.2)

renderUI({
  downloadButton("downloadFile", "Download All")
})

```


```{r}
val <- reactiveValues(dfExisting = NULL, dfNew  = NULL, rSeed = NULL, alloc=NULL, k=NULL, predicatbility = 1, patien_id=NULL)#, k=c(cntrl=2, expA=3, expB=1))


observe({
  req(input$RandomSeed)
  rSeed = try(as.integer(input$RandomSeed))
  if (inherits(rSeed, "error")) {showNotification("Seed must be a number"); return(NULL);}
  val$rSeed = rSeed;
})

observe({
  req(input$existing_patients, cancelOutput = TRUE)
  theFile = input$existing_patients
  tmp <- read.csv(theFile$datapath)
  val$dfExisting <- tmp
  if ("arm" %in% names(tmp))
    updateTextAreaInput(session, inputId = "spots_k", value = paste(paste(unique(tmp$arm), " = 0"), collapse=", "))
})

observe({
  req(input$new_patients, cancelOutput = TRUE)
  theFile = input$new_patients
  tmp <- read.csv(theFile$datapath)
  val$dfNew <- tmp
  updateSelectInput(session, "patient_id", choices=names(tmp))
})

observe({
  req(input$RandomSeed, cancelOutput = TRUE)
  val$rSeed = input$RandomSeed
})

observe({
  req(input$patient_id, cancelOutput = TRUE)
  req(input$new_patients, cancelOutput = T)
  val$patient_id = input$patient_id
})

observe({
  shinyjs::disable("randomness")
  req(input$randomness)
  val$predictability = 0.8 #1-input$randomness
})

observe({
  req(input$spots_k, cancelOutput = TRUE)
  txt = input$spots_k
  if (!all(grepl("\\w+\\s*=\\s*\\d", strsplit(txt,",")[[1]]))) {
    showNotification("Error in 'Available spots'")
    return(NULL)
  }
  e = try(eval(parse(text = paste("c(", gsub("(\\w+)(\\s*=\\s*\\d+)", '"\\1"\\2', txt), ")"))))
  if (inherits(e, "error")) {
    showNotification("Error in 'Available spots'")
  } else {
    val$k = e
  }
})

observe({
  req(val$dfExisting, cancelOutput = TRUE)
  req(val$dfNew, cancelOutput = TRUE)
  req(val$k, cancelOutput = TRUE)
  new = val$dfNew
  df = val$dfExisting
  k = val$k

  set.seed(val$rSeed)
  val$alloc = tryCatch(
    groupTherapyAllocate(df, new, k, input$patient_id, val$predictability), 
    error = traceback,
    finaly = print("Exiting computing val$alloc")
  )
})
```


```{r}
output$downloadFile <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {paste('allocation-(', input$spots_k,",seed=",val$rSeed,")-", Sys.Date(), '.csv', sep='')},
  content = function(con) {
    if (!is.null(val$alloc)) {
      df = attr(val$alloc, "combined_patients")
      df = as.data.frame(as.matrix(as.data.frame(df)))
      write.csv(df, con, quote = 1:ncol(df), row.names=FALSE)
    }
  })
```


Row {.tabset .tabset-fade}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Existing patients allocation

Existing patients should tabulate all patients that have already been enrolled in
any of the therapy arms. All covariates should be **factors**. There should be
one factor called **arm** which specifies the therapy are to which the patient
was admitted.

```{r}
renderTable({
  req(val$dfExisting)
  val$dfExisting
}, options = list(scrollY = '350px', paging = FALSE, scrollX = TRUE))
```


### New patients to allocate

New patients should tabulate all patients to consider for allocation. All covariates
should be the same **factors** as for Existing patients. If one of the columns contains
a patient ID, specify the name of the column in 'Patient ID'.

```{r}
renderTable({
  req(val$dfNew)
  val$dfNew
}, options = list(scrollY = '350px', paging = FALSE, scrollX = TRUE))
```


### Generated allocation 


```{r}
renderTable({
  req(val$alloc)
  val$alloc
}, options = list(scrollY = '350px', paging = FALSE, scrollX = TRUE))
```
